title: About Green Treemap Silence Field
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1210 recent saved-signal files and 314 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @basementstudio: gm, today we're launching Shader Lab, like photoshop but for shaders • design... and YouTube Music Library, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Green Treemap Silence Field: A green treemap silence field, game-space surface composition in overhead scan grammar: vast off-white negative space surrounds one rounded slab of nested glowing green rectangles, cut by crisp black seams and a thin horizontal measure line. Two hero source marks dominate quietly: the slab and a low bass-pressure st... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against large nested green enamel slab, long warm lower pressure seam, and dark chipped corner badges.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
